{{Quote|As Burzon explains, the Zhell nations were battered by the loss of their capital, but not broken: They recovered and drove the Taungs off Notron entirely.|Eschul Shaywa|<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref>}}
'''Mesh Burzon''' was a [[Historian/Legends|historian]] who worked at the [[University of Byblos/Legends|University of Byblos]]. He notably studied [[Zhell–Taung war|the conflict]] that opposed the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]] and the [[Taung/Legends|Taungs]] around [[200,000 BBY]] and, as such, was mentioned in an article penned by [[Eschul Shaywa]] for ''[[Imperial Center Today]]''.
